name: fivedrisk
description: Deployment-specific 5D risk profiling, setup, verification, and recovery guidance for AI-agent action governance.

interface.longDescription: An advisory deployment consultant: profile an agent's likely actions from a redacted system prompt or goals, compare deterministic and optional observer designs, configure supported runtime adapters, and verify fail-closed behavior. Installing this skill alone does not enforce an action policy.
defaultPrompt: Help me design and verify a 5D risk profile for my AI agent.
Review my agent's redacted system prompt and propose a 5D deployment profile.
Compare deterministic 5D with an observer LLM or TypeSafe Jev for my agent.
